title: Get started with SticsREval
text: workflow three stages, handled plain functions taking explicit arguments: Prepare data: build STICS text workspace SMS repository gen_workspace_from_sms(), run STICS version run_simulations(). produces RDS files simulations observations. Evaluate: compare candidate version observations reference version evaluate(), check water nitrogen balances balance_closure_test(). Report: render exported results HTML dashboard render_report(). evaluate() balance_closure_test() never run STICS : read RDS files produced run_simulations(). Simulations can thus computed evaluated many times.

title: Get started with SticsREval
text: gen_workspace_from_sms() converts SMS repository (XML input files) STICS text workspace, one folder per USM: restrict workspace USMs, pass names usms. can read text files listing one USM per line read_usms_files():
code: gen_workspace_from_sms(   sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",   stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",   output_dir = "workspace/" ) usms <- read_usms_files(c("usms_wheat.txt", "usms_maize.txt"))  gen_workspace_from_sms(   sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",   stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",   output_dir = "workspace/",   usms       = usms )

title: Get started with SticsREval
text: Run reference version . run_simulations() writes simulations.rds observations.rds output_dir: default, simulated variables observed ones. balance closure test needs additional, non-observed variables: use get_var_from_obs() combine sets single run candidate version.
code: run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_reference",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "reference/" ) balance_vars <- c(   "init_H2O_balance", "final_H2O_balance",   "init_plant_N_balance", "final_plant_N_balance",   "init_soil_mineral_N_balance", "final_soil_mineral_N_balance",   "init_soil_organic_N_balance", "final_soil_organic_N_balance",   "init_soil_organic_C_balance", "final_soil_organic_C_balance" )  obs <- SticsRFiles::get_obs("workspace/") vars <- c(get_var_from_obs(obs), balance_vars)  run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_candidate",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   vars           = vars )

title: Get started with SticsREval
text: evaluate() runs three evaluations candidate version: global: statistics species USMs combined; per species: variables whose rRMSE deteriorates percentage % compared reference flagged; per USM: USMs one variables locally degraded compared reference flagged. Results (CSV files, RDS files data degraded variables) written output_dir, summary printed console. Without ref_sim_rds, candidate version evaluated observations . Set stop_on_failure = TRUE make evaluate() throw error evaluation fails, e.g. CI pipeline.
code: evaluate(   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   sim_rds        = "outputs/simulations.rds",   obs_rds        = "outputs/observations.rds",   ref_sim_rds    = "reference/simulations.rds",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   percentage     = 5 )

title: Evaluate and Compare STICS Crop Model Versions
text: SticsREval evaluates candidate version STICS crop model field observations reference version: statistical evaluation (evaluate()): global, per-species per-USM comparison candidate version reference; balance closure test (balance_closure_test()): consistency water nitrogen balances; HTML dashboard (render_report()) browse results. See Get started vignette full workflow reference function’s arguments.

title: Evaluate and Compare STICS Crop Model Versions
text: restore exact dependency versions recorded renv.lock cloning repository, run renv::restore(). render_report() also requires Quarto CLI, R package must installed separately (included Docker image).

title: Evaluate and Compare STICS Crop Model Versions
code: library(SticsREval)  # Build a STICS workspace from the SMS repository gen_workspace_from_sms(   sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",   stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",   output_dir = "workspace/" )  # Run the reference and candidate versions run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_reference",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "reference/" ) run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_candidate",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "outputs/" )  # Evaluate the candidate version and render the dashboard evaluate(   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   sim_rds        = "outputs/simulations.rds",   obs_rds        = "outputs/observations.rds",   ref_sim_rds    = "reference/simulations.rds",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   report         = TRUE )

title: Run All Evaluations — evaluate
text: Invisibly NULL. Called side effects: workspace creation, evaluation runs, console reporting.

title: Run All Evaluations — evaluate
text: function proceeds following steps: Creates temporary evaluation workspace, cleaned exit. Loads simulation/observation/reference data . Runs global, per-species per-USM evaluations. Exports results output_dir defined. Prints respective summaries. Displays CLI report listing evaluation success (green ✔), failed (red ✗) evaluated (yellow, reason, e.g. reference data). Stops error least one evaluation failed (stop_on_failure).

title: SticsREval (development version)
text: New plot_rrmse_comparison() function plot rRMSE evaluated version reference version, one point per variable, coloured regression status (#69). New overview_heatmap() function show status every variable every species single heatmap, report’s homepage. New usm_ratio_heatmap() function show RMSE ratio USM evaluation USM variable, coloured according degraded critical thresholds. Quarto report generated render_report() refactored cleaned (#68). evaluate() longer writes one HTML scatter plot per degraded variable plots/<species>/. now saves, species degraded variables, observations simulations data/<species>_degraded_vars.rds, species pages report draw scatter plots .

title: SticsREval 0.1.1
text: rRMSE comparison plots now shown HTML report (#66). minimum number observations criterion (n_obs >= 10) now applied consistently across global, species USM evaluations (#65).

title: SticsREval 0.1.0
text: First tagged release. evaluate() runs global, per-species per-USM statistical evaluations STICS version field observations reference version. balance_closure_test() checks water nitrogen balance closure USM. gen_workspace_from_sms() builds STICS text workspace raw SMS repository, run_simulations() runs STICS saves simulation observation data RDS files. render_report() renders evaluation results browsable HTML dashboard. Docker image bundling package, dependencies Quarto CLI published GitHub Container Registry.
